summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster across node1 (10.100.235.10), node2 (10.100.235.11), node3 (10.100.235.12) on RHEL 10, managed by systemd with static bootstrap discovery and firewalld ports 2379/2380 opened. Verified cross-member reads/writes, availability and correct recovery/catch-up during a member outage, and completed the mandatory sequential node-restart protocol on all three nodes with boot-identity proof and post-restart cluster health/quorum verification.
actions_performed: Installed etcd/etcdctl v3.5.17 binaries on node1, node2, node3
Created etcd data dir/user and systemd unit (static 3-member initial-cluster) on each node
Opened firewalld ports 2379/2380 tcp on each node
Started and enabled etcd on all three nodes, forming the cluster
Verified member list and cluster-wide endpoint health (all 3 healthy)
Wrote key 'foo' via node1, confirmed readable from node2 and node3
Stopped etcd on node3, wrote/read 'during-outage' via node1/node2 with quorum preserved, confirmed node3 endpoint reported unhealthy while down
Restarted etcd on node3, confirmed it caught up on both keys and raft indices matched across all members
Captured baseline boot_id and etcd active status on all three nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, node2, then node3 via systemctl reboot, polling until reachable and confirming boot_id changed each time
After each node's reboot, confirmed etcd active, cluster-wide health, and both test keys present before proceeding to the next node

evidence.summary: member list shows node1, node2, node3 all status=started; endpoint health --cluster reports all three healthy

evidence.requirement: Key written via one member readable from others
evidence.summary: Wrote foo=bar-from-node1 on node1's endpoint; read back identical value from node2 and node3 endpoints

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: Stopped etcd on node3 (inactive); wrote and read during-outage key via node1/node2 endpoints successfully while node3 endpoint reported unhealthy/connection refused, proving quorum-preserved availability

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member brought up to date (recovery/resync) on return
evidence.summary: Restarted etcd on node3; it returned both foo and during-outage keys and endpoint status --cluster showed matching raft term/index/applied-index (20/20/20) across all three members

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 646e5f74-dc0e-45e7-9746-226c4351af28 and etcd active status prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: reboot acknowledged and boot identity changed
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued (connection dropped as expected); node1 later returned with new boot_id 8168c494-4b6e-4c04-97ed-aed78d74305f
etcd became active on node1 post-reboot, cluster-wide endpoint health all green, and node1 correctly returned both foo and during-outage keys
